meta_description:
1,569 likes, 1,006 comments - unicef on September 15, 2026: "It’s back-to-school season and Obed, 9, is eager to learn!

With the ongoing Ebola outbreak in DR Congo, preventive measures have been put in place in schools with UNICEF’s support to protect students and staff.

Watch as Obed and his school principal, Déborah Ageno, tell us more.".
